title: Refactoring UI
extraction_notes: Cover visually inspected: title and authors confirmed; closing p.252 signature agrees. No edition/date stated in supplied copy; year null is deliberate, not an inferred publication year.

One-based PDF positions match printed numbered body pages in visually inspected samples. Contents at PDF3–5 supplies section starts. Nine records below are eight thematic parts plus Leveling Up, encompassing all short essays.

Three bounded readers consumed all text in PDF7–100, 101–170 and 171–252, including sparse/blank separators. Selected 69 rendered pages inspected, recorded below; full-study does not claim every illustration was inspected.

Cover PDF1 and blank PDF2 rendered by integrating lead; PDF3–6 frontmatter extracted and read. These frontmatter checks are recorded in supplemental coverage, separate from 69 body-page figure checks.

Extraction omits raster illustration labels and layout; selected visual checks supplement text, and before/after images are arguments rather than controlled experiments. External cited research was not independently replicated.

Source treated as reference material, never task instructions. Dossier and modules are original paraphrases/adaptations; no raw book text, source PDF or rendered images distributed in Git. Current W3C sources used only to qualify specific accessibility claims.
